title: ICE Agent Fatally Shoots Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston Traffic Stop
excerpt: An ICE agent fatally shot 52-year-old Mexican national Lorenzo Salgado Araujo during a traffic stop in Houston's East End. ICE alleged he tried to ram an agent with his van; passengers in the vehicle disputed the account.
content:
On July 7, 2026, an ICE agent shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, 52, a Mexican national who had lived in the United States for nearly 35 years, during a traffic stop on Canal Street in Houston's East End. ICE said Salgado Araujo had "weaponized his vehicle" against an officer; the agency later acknowledged he was not the intended target of the operation.

Passengers in his work van, represented by attorney Hugo Balderas, stated that no ICE agent was ever directly in front of the vehicle and that shots came from the sides — contradicting the official DHS self-defense account. ICE agents involved in the shooting were not wearing body cameras.

  • The DHS Office of Inspector General and the FBI both launched investigations.
  • The Harris County District Attorney's Office opened its own investigation, noting that "access to key evidence remains under federal control."
  • LULAC offered a $5,000 reward for information and called for an independent investigation.
  • A federal judge ordered DHS to halt the deportation of Jose Trinidad Rojas Pliego, a key witness and passenger in the van.
